name: Automated personal tax computation data lake

mentions.name: Automated personal tax computation data lake
mentions.description: This automation computes the author's taxes fully, handling complications like international income and different asset types. It is built as a data lake that processes financial data in various formats and computes results, moving manual drudgery and complicated Excel spreadsheets into code.
mentions.problem: Computing taxes fully is complicated because of international income and different assets, traditionally requiring lots of manual drudgery and complicated Excel sheets.
mentions.source_excerpt: Now I'm automating computing my taxes fully which gets pretty complicated because of international income, different assets etc. Its basically a data lake to process all kinds of financial data in various formats and compute stuff, moving lots of manual drudgery and complicated excel sheets into code.
